title: Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Term and Visit Spacing Schedule
content:
# Term and Visit Spacing Schedule

Each tier of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans includes a fixed number of maintenance visits and runs for a term counted both in months from the sale date and in miles beyond the odometer at sale. Visits are spaced by a mileage interval, with a mileage tolerance before the interval and a minimum count of calendar days between visits.

| Plan | Visits included | Term (months from sale date) | Term (miles beyond odometer at sale) | Service interval (miles) | Interval tolerance (miles) | Fewest calendar days between visits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | 2 | 24 | 15000 | 5000 | 1000 | 60 |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | 4 | 24 | 25000 | 5000 | 1000 | 60 |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | 6 | 36 | 35000 | 5000 | 1000 | 60 |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | 8 | 48 | 45000 | 5000 | 1000 | 60 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | 10 | 60 | 60000 | 7500 | 1000 | 90 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | 12 | 36 | 75000 | 5000 | 1000 | 45 |

## Column meanings

- **Visits included**: the number of maintenance visits the plan includes.
- **Term (months)**: the plan term in months from the sale date.
- **Term (miles)**: the plan term in miles beyond the odometer at sale.
- **Service interval**: the miles between scheduled plan visits.
- **Interval tolerance**: the miles before the next interval at which a visit is still accepted.
- **Fewest calendar days between visits**: the fewest calendar days between two redeemed visits when the mileage interval has not been reached.

## Notes on the schedule

- Every tier uses a 1000-mile interval tolerance. On a 5000-mile interval, the mileage side of the spacing is therefore met at 4000 miles; on the 7500-mile interval of the Premium tier, it is met at 6500 miles.
- The Fleet tier has the longest mileage term (75000 miles) and the shortest day spacing (45 days). The Premium tier has the longest month term (60 months) and the longest day spacing (90 days).
